instructions_to_main_agent: Use JavaScript (.js / .jsx), NOT TypeScript (.tsx), as per project specifications.
Implement the full Robson Club Multi-Tenant SaaS UI with interactive role switching: 'Influencer (Robson)', 'Parceiro (Tivoli Lisboa)', and 'Admin Geral'.

Follow the user locked visual direction strictly: Light canvas (#F8F9FC / white cards), rich purple accent (#7C3AED / #6D28D9 / soft #EDE9FE), deep obsidian-purple sidebar (#0C0A14), soft card drop shadows, rounded pill badges.
Provide responsive drawer / mobile navigation toggle for smaller screens.
Include high fidelity Recharts AreaChart with purple gradient fill for 'Evolução de Utilizações'.
Interactive Coupon Redemption validator with live discount calculation, receipt modal, and mock camera scanner modal.

Ensure every interactive and key informational element contains a clear data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='role-switcher-dropdown', data-testid='kpi-revenue-card', data-testid='validate-coupon-button', data-testid='qr-code-featured-card').
Set language strictly to PT-PT ('Regiões: Lisboa, Porto, Algarve, Douro', 'Partilhar', 'Receita Gerada', 'Comissão Devida', currency '€').
Export to CSV simulated functionality with Sonner toast feedback.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.tone: Ultra-clean European luxury SaaS for high-end hospitality & lifestyle creators
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.toast_library: sonner (use Sonner toast for copy link, coupon validation, partner referral actions)
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.interactive_feedback: Every button has active press scales and hover tint states with high contrast
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast_compliance: APCA and WCAG AA standard met for all dark sidebar text and light card text
